name: keel
description: Keel focus & time tracker: test and tooling setup (the app itself has no build step)

scripts.lint: eslint . && ruff check tracker tests perf && ruff format --check tracker tests perf && mypy
scripts.test:js: rm -f coverage/js-v8.jsonl && KEEL_COVERAGE=1 playwright test --project=unit && node tests/js/coverage-report.mjs
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:py && npm run test:js && npm run test:e2e
